title: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina Part 5: DNA Purification
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare TE buffer and ethanol columns
steps.instruction: Prepare TE buffer and ethanol columns as described; one TE buffer column can accommodate three sample columns per wash column, and one ethanol column can accommodate four sample columns. If using more than one reagent column, split the reagent volumes equally among all columns.

steps.title: Add samples to magnetic plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the samples into the magnetic plate wells.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads to samples
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of magnetic beads to each sample well.

steps.title: Incubate bead binding
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate to allow beads to bind to the nucleic acids.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Place the plate on a magnetic stand, allow beads to collect, then remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Perform two ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Add ethanol wash buffer to the beads, briefly incubate, then remove the supernatant; repeat this wash a second time.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Allow the beads to air‑dry on the magnetic stand until no residual ethanol remains.

steps.title: Elute cDNA with TE
steps.instruction: Add TE buffer to the beads to elute cDNA and incubate to facilitate elution.

steps.title: Transfer cDNA to final plate
steps.instruction: Move the eluted cDNA from the magnetic plate into the final destination plate.
